messages:
maria: Heads up — main CI turned red after the poetry lockfile regen. A couple of unit tests in tests/validators/test_format.py are failing with AssertionError, looks like a jsonschema validation message changed.
ci-bot: Build #9823 · tests-py39 FAILED — https://ci.redwood.internal/9823 (logs attached)
sam: can you paste the failing trace snippet?
maria: sure — here's the failing part from the job log:
```
E   AssertionError: 'is not of type' not found in "None is not of type 'object'"
tests/validators/test_format.py:47: in test_object_rejection
    assert 'is not of type' in str(err)
```
alex: hmm that looks like a formatting tweak in jsonschema error messages. Did the lockfile pull a newer jsonschema?
maria: checking poetry.lock — yes, jsonschema bumped to 4.18.0 in the regen, previously we had 3.2.0 pinned in older lockfile.
jin: i can repro locally on py39: `poetry install && pytest tests/validators/test_format.py::test_object_rejection -q` — same failure.
sam: ok two quick options: pin back to 3.x in pyproject/lock to get CI green, or update tests to not rely on exact error text. i'd prefer the latter but short-term pin is faster. @alex can you run a lockfile bisect to confirm the culprit commit?
alex: starting quick bisect against lockfile history now, will report the commit where jsonschema version changed.
devops-bot: :repeat: Rerun job available — click to retry.
maria: i'd like a hotfix PR to get main green. i'll do a pin now and open a follow-up task to make assertions use error.validator / error.path instead of string matching.
sam: i'll open PR with a temporary constraint `jsonschema = "^3.2.0"` and note the reason in the PR description.
alex: bisect complete — bump came from merge of deps-bump/PR #4217 (lock regen). Confirmed jsonschema 4.x introduced the different message formatting.
sam: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4521 :arrow_up: (pins jsonschema to 3.2.x and adds a test comment).
ci-bot: Re-run queued for PR 4521 · job tests-py39
maria: thanks — once PR passes i'll merge. i'll follow up next week to refactor the tests so they check ValidationError.schema_path / .validator instead of fragile message text.
jin: happy to help with the refactor.
sam: thanks everyone, quick triage worked — will monitor for any other deps that rely on jsonschema 4.x behavior.
